data.narrative:
Stegra is a Growth-stage climate and energy company founded by Carl-Erik Lagercrantz and Harald Mix that has raised $7.0B+ to date. The sector peer universe consists of 9 companies—1 public (Linnea Oil: LNZA) and 8 private firms including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen—though same-stage and valuation-adjacent comparables within this set are insufficient for reliable peer-median triangulation.

Given data constraints, valuation analysis relies on stage-progression methodology. Using the $7.0B total raised as a proxy for enterprise value, application of a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement yields an implied valuation of $8.4B. This method is applicable but reflects a narrow methodological base: peer-median analysis was not feasible because fewer than three datapoints emerged from tight same-stage and adjacent-stage filters within the Climate & Energy sector.

The analysis supports a range of $7.1B to $9.7B, centered on $8.4B. The wide spread reflects reliance on a single method and sparse narrow peer data. Key uncertainties include (1) the appropriateness of the 1.2x multiplier for Stegra's specific market position and growth trajectory, (2) absence of recent transaction or financing data for comparable Growth-stage climate-tech companies, and (3) whether $7.0B raised adequately proxies current enterprise value absent a recent valuation event.
